verdict.rationale: Airweave is an agent knowledge and retrieval layer, so a configurable entity or ontology schema is a fair question to ask of it. The pack does not show users defining custom entity types, edge types or ontologies. It only mentions that the search agent navigates built-in parent/child/sibling entity hierarchies, and that you can build new source connectors, which is never described as a way to customize the memory schema.
